purpose: Teach: 有能/異例/セクター/ワイド/賞金/物品/非常勤/マネジャー

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 有能な新人を採用しましょう
lines.en: Let's bring on a capable new hire.
lines.style: Authoritative, measured opening. Businesslike and forward-looking. Crisp articulation. The tone of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の異例の躍進が、新聞で紹介されました
lines.en: Yes. Our company's impressive growth got coverage in the newspaper.
lines.style: Bright acknowledgment, genuinely pleased. Reports back with pride but without overstatement. Steady pace, eye contact maintained.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: IT セクターでの新規事業を検討しましょう
lines.en: We should look into new ventures in the IT sector.
lines.style: Next-item efficiency. Decisive, planning-forward tone. Slight lean-in to the proposal. Same authority as the opening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ワイドな視野で進めます
lines.en: Yes. We'll move forward with a broad perspective.
lines.style: Confirming with a note of initiative. Not just passive agreement — shows he's already thinking. Warm but professional.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新人賞金制度を整えましょう
lines.en: Let's also establish a new employee incentive program.
lines.style: Building momentum. Confident delegation. Another decision stated clearly, not tentatively. Light emphasis on 'also' — adding to the agenda.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内物品の在庫管理を電子化しました
lines.en: Yes. I've already digitized the inventory management system for office supplies.
lines.style: Proud update delivered without fanfare. Shows he's been ahead of the curve. Quiet competence. 'Already' lands with subtle emphasis.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 非常勤社員の研修も組みましょう
lines.en: And let's organize training for our part-time staff too.
lines.style: Inclusive scope-building. Not an afterthought — spoken with the same weight as the earlier initiatives. Inclusive of all employees.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。マネジャー候補を育てる方針を進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'm moving forward with a plan to develop management candidates from within.
lines.style: Closing statement with forward momentum. Personal ownership — 'I'm moving' not just 'will move'. Steady, confident, forward-looking.
